segments.title: This RAT weighed as much as a dog
segments.say: This ancient rodent weighed about as much as a big dog.

segments.title: Lived 34 million years ago
segments.say: It lived about thirty four million years ago, in what's now Thailand.

segments.title: Known from just 2 teeth
segments.say: Scientists only have two of its teeth, so the weight is a ballpark guess.

segments.title: Twice any rodent of its time
segments.say: That's about twice the size of other rodents from its time. Meet Yakamys.

segments.title: Source: Scientific Reports
segments.say: The study is in Scientific Reports.
